static_traits.name: Li Na
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide academic worries in, but unwilling to discuss the Fear of left turns with friends; daily Anxiety affects Learning and Work performance
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems or treatment history in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe physiological and emotional experiences; negative tone, many worries; able to accept exploring and trying new perspectives, cooperativeness fair

basic_info.main_problem: The client experiences Fear and Anxiety related to making left turns while driving, and firmly believes they will fail the Women's studies course; after a low score at the start of the semester, persistently worries the teacher thinks they are stupid.
basic_info.core_demands: These problems significantly affect my daily life, causing Increased stress, and affecting my Work and Learning performance.
growth_experiences: After a 'near-miss' event while driving, the client began to have a strong fear of left turns: when approaching a left-turn intersection, the heartbeat accelerates, the palms sweat, and they feel panicky; afterwards it gradually developed into avoiding left-turn routes, causing obstructed commuting and increased stress.

After receiving a low score on one assignment/assessment at the start of the semester, the client developed persistent worry about academic failure, accompanied by excessive attention to the teacher's evaluation; strong Anxiety and Self-doubt appear before each assignment deadline, and although later receiving the teacher's positive feedback of 'making progress', it remains hard to ease worries about failure and being negated.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/insufficiently capable
I cannot effectively cope with complex or dangerous situations

special_situations.event: After receiving a low grade at the start of the term, faces courses and assignments again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I once got a low score, it proves I am not smart enough, and I will keep failing in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: High Anxiety before each assignment, constantly seeking friends' comfort to ease uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough, I will probably fail again

special_situations.event: In class or after receiving feedback, recalls the teacher's view of him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the teacher has not explicitly affirmed me or once gave me a low score, it means he thinks I am stupid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids direct communication with the teacher, repeatedly applies negative labels in the mind
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The teacher must think I am stupid

special_situations.event: Needing to make a left turn in heavy traffic
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a left turn, an accident will happen, I cannot control it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively detours, tries to avoid left-turn sections to reduce fear
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do it, something will definitely go wrong

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance this time is not perfect enough, I will fail and prove I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly worries, seeks reassurance from friends, hard to focus on tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might fail the course, this time definitely will not work either

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized, affirmed as a capable and respectable Student and individual
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being evaluated as stupid or inadequate, fearing losing control and accidents in dangerous situations
defense_goal: Reducing the possibility of being negated and losing control through avoidance (avoiding left turns, avoiding direct communication with the teacher)
Easing Anxiety and uncertainty by seeking others' comfort, maintaining a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A student who is not good enough and prone to failure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others mention the teacher's views on their performance, or explore beliefs related to their 'failure'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously projecting Self-denial onto others, believing others (especially the teacher) will belittle oneself like the inner judge
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying or ignoring positive feedback, repeatedly emphasizing 'I am not good enough', hesitant tone, avoiding direct communication with the teacher lest it confirm being negated.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to face turning left or reduce avoidance behavior
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Absolutizes real-world risks, believing that persisting in avoidance is the 'rational and safe' choice
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explains using factual items such as 'the traffic is too complicated / rush hour is too dangerous', objective and detached tone, avoiding discussing inner fears and emotions.

manifestations: After one driving near-miss, worry about left turns possibly causing accidents increased markedly
Highly sensitive to and avoidant of the possibility of 'something happening' in busy traffic conditions
outcomes: Persistent physiological Anxiety and tension experience

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss the Fear of left turns with friends, worrying about being misunderstood or judged
Although able to seek comfort on academic issues, still feeling Self-doubt is hard to truly understand

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently blaming oneself and negating the self with 'I am not good enough / I will fail'
Especially cautious when facing assignments and feedback, hard to take in positive information

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming 'the teacher thinks I am stupid', projecting inner Self-doubt onto others' views
Avoiding direct communication with the teacher, lest the imagination of 'confirming being negated' comes true

exception_events.target_problem: When facing course tasks and teacher evaluation, the client typically presupposes failure and believes the teacher looks down on them, thus highly Anxiety, unable to focus on Learning.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the most recent assignment, the teacher explicitly pointed out 'you have improved'; compared with past low scores and Self-denial, this time showed signs of positive feedback and objective progress.
exception_events.reason: Different support: positive feedback from the teacher; different understanding: noticing oneself is not consistently failing, beginning to see evidence of improvement.

positive_force: There is real positive evidence (the teacher affirmed 'there is progress')
Willing to try cognitive restructuring and 'reality testing', with good cooperation
Has friends who can provide emotional support and comfort for studies
Has safely completed left turns many times in the past, with a memory basis of success experience
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading marked
Avoidance behavior maintaining Anxiety (like actively detouring to avoid left turns)
Relying on external recognition to ease uncertainty, easily falling into repeated reassurance-seeking
Negative self-labels ('I am stupid / not good enough') solidified, undermining confidence
Rush-hour traffic and approaching assignment deadlines as high-frequency trigger situations, easily activating physiological tension and Fear

target_behavior.behavior: Intense fear and avoidance of left turns while driving
antecedent: Approaching an intersection requiring a left turn, especially during busy traffic periods
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic beliefs about left turns and loss-of-control Anticipation formed after the dangerous experience, conditional Fear being Reinforced
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome stimuli (potential danger and strong Anxiety)
target_behavior.consequence: Detours and commuting obstruction, daily stress rises, affecting life and work efficiency

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry about course failure and Self-denial, accompanied by frequent reassurance-seeking
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and negative self-labeling triggered by one low score; excessive reliance on others' evaluations to maintain self-worth
target_behavior.function: Gaining others' comfort to relieve uncertainty and Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: LearningDecreased concentration, WorkLearningPerformance affected, Anxiety and pressure persisting
